1.consolidated_definition: Mirar con cuidado, notar, advertir una cosa (pero también, con sentido abstracto, ‘considerar, reflexionar’). “Lo que eres tú agora no reparas en ná.” Meléndez Muñoz.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To look at something carefully, notice or observe a thing (but also, in an abstract sense, 'to consider, reflect'). "What you are now does not pay attention to anything." Meléndez Muñoz.
